skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Almond Platter
skins.content: 0011 New Arrivals/Almond Platter. Outfit Almond wore during a field mission in Yan. Deep crimsons are a natural complement to the festive atmosphere, while the long skirt and wide sleeves bring out her latent cuteness.
skins.quote: Almond looks around her. Sesame balls, green peas, biscuits, jujubes... All in all, a very sweet dream. But she soon realizes she's at the center of the platter. 'Hey, am I one of the snacks—?!'
